```csharp title="C#"

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<ul><li>Parent<ul><li>Child</li></ul></li></ul>", new ConversionOptions { ListIndentType = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ListIndentType>("\"Tabs\"", ConfigOptions)! });
```
